items.title: A finite algebra over a henselian pair with finite closed fibre
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the finite companion of the preceding preparatory statements: for a finite algebra over a henselian pair whose closed fibre is finite over the residue field, it produces a decomposition and verifies the properties that the following statements of the section require. The proof is a 43-line argument which uses the lifting of idempotents to split the algebra and then checks that the pieces are again finite over the pair with finite closed fibre. The decomposition and the verification are both written out.
